general_information.Syllabus Name: Intellectual Property Rights_Luật sở hữu trí tuệ
general_information.Description: Teach the fundamental concepts, principles, rules and doctrines concerning types of intellectual property rights relating graphic design, particularly, copyright, trademark and registered design. Students will learn how to apply these principles and rules in protection of their intellectual property rights in relation to their graphic works. During the course, there are some typical cases regarding intellectual property rights in respect of graphic designs available for students to analysize and discuss. Students are also taught basic skills to prevent from infringement of other person's intellectual property rights when they produce their graphic works. How to commercialize intellectual property right is the incorporated part of the subject as well.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbooks in advance - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. - Computer with some version of photograph editing software such as Photoshop, Microsoft Word for written assignments, and POWERPOINT for presentations - keep in touch with lecturer regularly for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the basic rules and doctrines regulating different types of intellectual property rights in connection with graphic design
Apply the aforesaid basic rules and doctrines to protect their intellectual property rights relating their graphic works
Understand elements of some typical infringements of intellectual property rights in connection with graphic design
Be able to discover infringement and take action against a person who infringes their intellectual property rights relating their graphic works
Understanding legal issues in relation to licensing
Apply what they learn to negotiate, form and perform a licensing agreement to transfer their intellectual property rights to other person.
Be able to study related law by themselves to prevent infringements of intellectual property rights of other author/ registered owner.
Understand how to take action against infringers

schedule.Topic: Unit 1: Introduction (1). Introduction to studying methods: textbooks, suggested readings, rules set out by Lecturer, syllabus, assessment, legal reasoning, and so on; instruct students how to prepare, complete and submit their individual assignments (2). Overview of intellectual property law with respect to graphic design: creation and justification for protecting intellectual property righs, introduction to the sources of law, and types of intellectual property right, overlapping protection and management of intellectual property rights

Unit 2: Copyright (1). What is copyright: the basic concepts and rules regarding copyright, moral rights & economic rights, types of copyright (2). Ownership and duration of copyright: Introduction to duration of copyright, basic rules regarding ownership of copyright; cases presented and discussed to illustrate ownership of copyright

Unit 2: Copyright (3). Infringement: infringement, take action against infringers, cases presented and discussed to illustrate copyright infringement, exceptions, justifications for exceptions, the balance between exclusive right and welfare. (4) Legal liabilities: damages, injunction, criminal liabilities, cases presented and discussed to illustrate liability for infringement

Unit 3: Rights in designs (1). Design right: What is design right, exceptions to design right, ownership of design right, infringement of design right; (2) Registered designs: What is a registered design, registration, infringement, ownerships of the right, infringement of a design registration; cases presented and discussed to illustrate registered design

Unit 4:Trademarks (1). Introduction to trademarks: types of trademark, registrable trademarks, registration of trademarks; unregistered trademarks, ownership of trademark rights; cases presented and discussed to illustrate registrable trademarks (2) Protection of trademark right: infringement of trademarks, comparative advertising, passing-off, legal liabilities for infringement, take action against infringement

Unit 5: Licensing (1). Introduction to licensing: the reasons for licensing, subject matters of licensing, types of license, financial compensation, and other rules regarding licensing (2) Cases presented and discussed to illustrate licensing
